description: Sessions favourited on ideasfest.uk (the ?plan= IDs) plus vedrí curation. IDs here are matched against data/sessions.json once the agenda is imported.

headliner-simon-squibb.why: Squibb built an audience with short-form video. Directly relevant to how vedrí wins creator and brand clients, and to our own content.

headliner-daniel-priestley.why: Positioning and demand for a niche studio. Priestley's 'oversubscribed' model is the playbook for a studio with limited stage days to sell.

simon-nicholls-sustainability-strategy.why: Sustainability is a real VP selling point (no location travel, less waste) but this is a general strategy talk. Go if nothing better clashes.

headliner-ruby-wax.why: Good energy, low commercial relevance. Worth it only as a break.

profile.who: vedrí — independent virtual production studio at DocShed, Gwynedd. Real-time green-screen compositing in-house, LED volumes hired in. Led by Daniel Evans.
goals: Win more brand, agency and creator clients for VP shoots (podcasts, corporate, commercials)
Sharpen positioning and pricing for a niche, capacity-limited studio
Learn how AI is changing video, content and production workflows
Meet founders who need video at scale (podcasters, course creators, DTC brands)
Understand funding, grants and growth options for a creative studio in North Wales
